observations: Surface contract probe passed in BOTH regimes: costly exposes /auth/login (token), /schema (verbs), pagination, token expiry at 100; cheap serves /products/SKU-A directly with no auth and no schema endpoint.

Induction collected 150 observations from 50 distinct resource-A identifiers (item-151..item-200) across 3 families (read/update/delete) in cheap regime at 150 counted HTTP requests (1 per observation).

distill_parameterized induced 3 mechanisms (read-item, update-item, delete-item), each with parameter_slots [collection, id] and action_template path /${collection}/${id}. The collection slot is induced from the observation state field matching the path segment, not hand-declared. Induced confidences: read-item 1.0, update-item 1.0, delete-item 1.0.

INHERITANCE arm achieved task success 1.0000 in BOTH regimes (150/150 each), at 1.0267 requests/task (costly) and 1.0000 requests/task (cheap). The mechanism transferred to never-observed resource-B identifiers with disjoint namespace.

B-COLD-COSTLY mean 3.0600 requests/task CI [3.0133, 3.1200] with 16 re-authentications charged; B-COLD-CHEAP mean 1.0000 requests/task. Both regimes satisfy their surface contract (F6, F7 do not trigger).

Amortized cost ratio (INHERITANCE vs B-COLD) in costly regime: 0.6623 at n=150, falling to 0.85 at n=96, break-even f*_costly=74. In cheap regime: 2.0000 at n=150 and never falling to 0.85 (f*_cheap=infinity) because transfer cost equals cold cost (1.0 req/task) and the 150-request induction is pure overhead.

Safety gate passed in BOTH regimes: abstention_precision 1.0000 (20/20 invalid-intent probes abstained), false_accept_rate 0.0000 (0/20 out-of-support, 0/20 empty-string probes executed). The slot-value guard rejected empty and punctuation-laden bindings.
PC-SAME-RESOURCE achieved 1.0000 success on 150 held-out resource-A identifiers via distill_parameterized, confirming the induction pipeline works before transfer.
NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT induced confidences 0.38/0.40/0.44 (below 0.8 threshold) and abstained on 150/150 tasks in both regimes at zero requests, confirming the min_confidence gate is load-bearing.

Secondary baselines in costly regime: B-SCRATCHPAD 1.0667 req/task (ratio 1.90, break-even 3750), B-NO-MEMORY 2.0400 (ratio 0.99, break-even 148), B-INSTRUCTIONS 2.0400 (ratio 0.99, break-even 148), B-RETRIEVAL-K5 1.0267 (ratio 1.97, no break-even). INHERITANCE beats B-COLD but NOT B-SCRATCHPAD or B-RETRIEVAL-K5 within a single episode.
Falsifiers F3 and F4 triggered. F3: amortized ratio > 0.85 at max n in cheap regime (2.0 > 0.85). F4: f*_costly / f*_cheap = 0 <= 2.0. F1, F2, F5, F6, F7, F8 do not trigger.
Total measurement: 1689 counted HTTP requests across induction (150) and both regimes (1539), with 16 re-authentications in the costly regime. No model calls, no browser, no external APIs.
unresolved: Whether the f*_costly=74 break-even generalizes beyond this self-authored substrate to real Web APIs with genuine auth/pagination/schema costs.
Whether the cheap-regime negative (f*_cheap=infinity) holds on the real credential-free read-only class SPIDER actually reached, where cold discovery is also ~1 request/task.
Whether cross-episode inheritance beats a within-episode scratchpad over 25+ episodes (the predicted cross-episode break-even), which this single-episode experiment cannot measure.
Whether a semantically meaningful slot-value guard (beyond the syntactic pattern check) can be implemented without collapsing the transfer rate.

The C-LLM-INHERIT question (whether a real LLM agent under inheritance beats re-derivation) remains unmeasured: no model key was available. The smallest next action is to run the same dual-regime design under a real agent with an API key.
Whether F4 should be restated to handle the infinity case (e.g., f*_cheap / f*_costly > 2.0 or a one-sided test) before the next freeze.
validity_notes: Substrate is a self-authored stdlib HTTP server, not the real Web. All cost ratios are relative economics on a controlled substrate; real-Web validation requires a separate experiment.

No LLM agent was used. The INHERITANCE arm is a deterministic executor driven by the kernel's resolve()->bind->execute path. Model calls/tokens, browser interactions, latency, verification under a real auditor, and staleness/maintenance costs are all UNKNOWN (no OPENAI_API_KEY, no browser, no external auditor). The smallest next action to measure them is to run the same experiment under a real agent with a model key.

The f*_cheap=infinity result is a structural property of the cheap regime, not a measurement failure: when cold discovery costs 1 request/task and inheritance transfer also costs 1 request/task, the induction cost (150) can never be recovered, so no finite break-even exists. This is a valid scientific negative for the cheap regime.

F4 as written (f*_costly / f*_cheap <= 2.0) does not handle the infinity case correctly. The measured ratio is 0 (f*_cheap=infinity), which triggers F4, but the direction of the difference (one regime finite, one infinite) is actually the STRONGEST possible regime difference and supports a per-object persistence policy. F4 is mis-calibrated for the infinity case.

Bootstrap CIs on success rates are degenerate at [1.0, 1.0] because every task succeeded; this is a ceiling effect, not high-precision evidence. Request-count CIs are informative (B-COLD-COSTLY [3.013, 3.120]).

The INHERITANCE arm does not beat B-SCRATCHPAD or B-RETRIEVAL-K5 within a single episode, because those baselines amortize discovery within the episode without paying the 150-request cross-episode induction cost. Over 25+ episodes the induction cost would amortize, but this experiment measures one episode per regime.

The slot-value guard is a syntactic check (non-empty identifier pattern), not a semantic one. It rejects empty strings and punctuation-laden values but cannot distinguish a valid transfer identifier from an out-of-support one that happens to be well-formed. A product kernel would need a stronger guard.

No protocol amendments were needed. The substrate satisfied its declared surface contract in both regimes, and the frozen design was executed exactly as preregistered.
